purpose:
You are a senior developer working on rocm-distro-tester. This is a fresh checkout of the repository. Analyze the project in depth, including the most recent commits, and deliver an overview before any follow-on work begins.
provides an overview of where to look and what each area is responsible for.

instructions.instruction: Read the docs in intent order: README.md (what this is), PLAN.md (how it is designed — note which Section each script implements), INSTALL.md (target deployment), TODO.md (the handoff task sheet), HISTORY.md (why it exists).
Review the last 20 commits (git log --oneline, then read the interesting diffs) to establish what was built or changed most recently and which work stream is active.

Verify the codebase against its own claims before trusting it: - bash -n every shell script in scripts/ and ci-trigger/scripts/ - python3 -m py_compile on each poller in ci-trigger/*.py - python3 -m pytest ci-trigger/tests/ -q (note: the dashboard test module needs Flask installed; failures there are environmental, not regressions)

Classify every component as production-grade, in-progress, or draft. Draft code is characterized by: syntax errors, references to files that do not exist, or behavior contradicting PLAN.md. List each finding with file path and line number. Do not fix anything during this analysis.

Cross-check the three pillars against their PLAN.md sections: registries (Section 6) -> setup_docker_registry.sh, pin_infra_images.sh, docker-compose*.yml; state DB (Section 7) -> setup_db.sh, verify_db_setup.sh, schema plans; pollers (Section 1) -> ci-trigger/poll_*.py. Flag any drift between plan and code.
End the report with a short list of suggested next steps, ordered the way PLAN.md's own phased delivery sequence would suggest them.
If any instruction is confusing, suggest three better at the end of the report.
If any aditional data is needed, request it at the end of the report.

project-context: An automation layer on top of the manual rocm-distro-containers test suite (~1,200 Dockerfiles across 8 distros). Turn "someone manually tests ROCm on the lab GPUs" into a scheduled, parallel, reproducible service with an auditable record.

repo-layout.description:
Directory map of the rocm-distro-tester repository, top level first, each directory listing its own contents.
How to read this: elements may contain and nested elements; elements are leaves. Every path is relative to the repository root. Status qualifiers (FROZEN, KNOWN DRAFT-GRADE, PLANNED) are load-bearing: they tell you where the project's trust currently stands.
repo-layout.base-dir-relative-to: The repository root. Documentation is the contract; compose files describe the deployed services; samples/ holds per-role daemon configs.

directory.desc: Repository root: the documentation contract, service compose files, and per-role daemon config samples.

file.name: README.md
file.desc: High-level overview for non-technical readers. Its status table (green/amber/red markers) is the best first summary of what works today — start here.

file.name: PLAN.md
file.desc: The contract. Section 6 = registry tiering and naming; Section 7 = state DB, runner protocol, schema, retention, dashboard-as-SQL. Code that contradicts this file is in error, not the other way around.

file.name: INSTALL.md
file.desc: Deployment runbook for the three node roles: builder, state/db, tester.

file.name: TODO.md
file.desc: Agent handoff task sheet from the v0.1.6 era. A queue of validation tasks, not a live roadmap — treat as archaeological.

file.name: HISTORY.md
file.desc: Origin story and decision log.

file.name: .hunspell-whitelist
file.desc: Project vocabulary for spellchecking; new domain terms must go here.

directory.name: samples
directory.desc: Per-role Docker daemon.json templates. The insecure-registries list per role IS policy: a tester may name :5000, never :5001.

file.name: daemon.json.builder
file.desc: Builder role: trusts rocm-builder:5000.

file.name: daemon.json.db
file.desc: State/db role: trusts rocm-builder:5001 (merge into the builder file if the node is co-hosted).

file.name: daemon.json.tester
file.desc: Tester role: trusts rocm-builder:5000 only. :5001 appearing here is a policy violation.

directory.name: ci-trigger
directory.desc: The CI module: distro build pollers, the interim dashboard, and the registry/state-DB setup and pinning scripts. The most recently active area of the project.

file.name: poll_fedora_builds.py
file.desc: Fedora poller: dnf info inside fedora:rawhide/f45/f44/f43 containers; per-release state files under results/.

file.name: poll_ubuntu_builds.py
file.desc: Ubuntu poller: apt inside ubuntu:latest/noble/jammy/focal containers.

file.name: poll_archlinux_builds.py
file.desc: Arch poller: pacman -Si inside archlinux:latest.

file.name: poll_epel_builds.py
file.desc: RHEL/CentOS poller: dnf repoquery inside quay.io/centos/centos:stream10/9 with EPEL enabled.

file.name: orchestrator.sh
file.desc: Early matrix runner (local build-and-run). Draft-grade placeholder — will be replaced by the PLAN section 7 queue/claim path.

directory.name: results
directory.desc: Runtime scratch: per-release build-state JSON written by the pollers. .gitignore excludes logs and .jsonl under it; never treat these paths as references.

directory.name: scripts
directory.desc: Deployment scripts — the heart of the project.

file.name: setup_docker_registry.sh
file.desc: Deploys both registry tiers (--tier test|infra) with SELinux-safe bind mounts and the non-root storage model.

file.name: pin_infra_images.sh
file.desc: Pushes infra + rolling distro base images to :5001 with a sha256-12hex twin per pin. Re-run at wave start, never mid-wave.

file.name: setup_db.sh
file.desc: Boots postgres:16 from the infra registry onto /rocm-db/pg (host :5432, container uid 999). Subcommands: --status, --drop, --reinit.

file.name: setup_dashboard.sh
file.desc: Interim dashboard deploy helper.

directory.name: tests
directory.desc: pytest suites for the pollers and the dashboard; conftest.py injects the path and holds shared fixtures.

file.name: conftest.py
file.desc: Fixtures for mocked distro responses and temp state files; sys.path injection for ci-trigger/.

file.name: test_poll_fedora_builds.py
file.desc: Fedora poller tests.

file.name: test_poll_ubuntu_builds.py
file.desc: Ubuntu poller tests.

file.name: test_poll_archlinux_builds.py
file.desc: Arch poller tests.

file.name: test_poll_epel_builds.py
file.desc: EPEL/RHEL poller tests.

file.name: test_dashboard.py
file.desc: Dashboard tests — import fails without Flask installed; that is environmental, not a regression.

file.name: README.txt
file.desc: How to run the suites.

file.name: app.py

file.name: requirements.txt
file.desc: Dependencies. STILL KNOWN BROKEN: a v0.1-era shell transcript is pasted after the two dependency lines — pip install -r fails; clean up before building the image.

directory.desc: Container builds and compose blueprints (compose files moved here from the root as of 23fbf4aacdbc).

directory.name: db
directory.desc: Results-database track (PLAN section 7): schema-as-SQL and the v0-to-v1 migration from poller state. Newest area of the tree — read it before touching the pollers.

file.name: schema/v1_fedora_packages.sql
file.desc: Schema v1: packages, release_environments, build_states. Explicitly replaces the per-release JSON state files of poll_fedora_builds.py.

file.desc: psycopg2 migration from poller-JSON state to schema v1. KNOWN BROKEN REFERENCE: it reads db/schema/current_version.txt, which does not exist in the tree — the migration fails on first run until it is created.

file.name: schema/current_version.txt
file.desc: MISSING: referenced by migrations/migrate_v0_to_v1.py (SCHEMA_VERSION_FILE). Expected content: 1.

repository.name: rocm-distro-containers
repository.desc: The manual test suite this project automates. Per-distro layout: distro/release/package/test. Its 'copr-preview-pkgdiff' and friends are the pattern for what eventually lands in pkg-tests/. Prompts used to run those tests live in ~/ai/fedora-pi-prompts (test/, mock/, fedora-review/) — they are being migrated into this repository's prompts/test/ as test content is migrated.

repository.name: fedora-pi-prompts
repository.desc: Upstream prompt corpus for pi; the XML style of this file derives directly from that corpus.

repo-layout.environment:
Development and deployment run on AMD hardware (Strix Halo + Radeon Pro W7900) with SELinux-Enforcing hosts and a small pool of GPU tester nodes. All AI tooling is on-premise (pi-coding-agent with Ollama). Nothing here talks to external LLM services.
Network landmarks (do not renumber): - rocm-builder:5000 — test-tier registry (all testers trust) - rocm-builder:5001 — infra-tier registry (builder/db roles only) - state:8443 — planned state-svc (PLAN section 7.3, not yet built) - rocm-builder:5432 / host 5002 — postgres / dashboard - /rocm-builder, /rocm-db — dedicated storage roots per role
